title.en: Publishing and signing the checkpoint, part 2 of 2: manifest and proof
title.es: Publicación y firma del checkpoint, parte 2 de 2: manifiesto y prueba

alt.en: seal.py writes manifest.json with rules_root and the log head. cosign signs it with sign-blob and manifest.sigstore.json returns to publish.yml. tlog.py release-proof then produces the inclusion proof for the candidate.accepted entry and inclusion-proof.json returns to publish.yml.
alt.es: seal.py escribe manifest.json con rules_root y la cabeza del registro. cosign lo firma con sign-blob y manifest.sigstore.json vuelve a publish.yml. Después tlog.py release-proof produce la prueba de inclusión de la entrada candidate.accepted e inclusion-proof.json vuelve a publish.yml.

legend.en: blue: step of publish.yml, tlog.py or seal.py; purple: signing with cosign; amber: verification; green: file returned to publish.yml.
legend.es: azul: paso de publish.yml, tlog.py o seal.py; morado: firma con cosign; ámbar: verificación; verde: archivo que vuelve a publish.yml.
